verdict.rationale: The Business & Liens portal lists "Data and Image Subscriptions" and a "Farm Product Monthly Subscription," which point to a first-party bulk data or extract offering that avoids scraping. The evidence is only menu-level titles, with no description of contents, format, delivery method, cost or access terms. Missing for 10: documented dataset contents and formats (e.g. CSV or registry extract schema), delivery mechanism and update cadence, access and licensing terms, free or open download availability, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the extracts are obtainable.
